name: Human-shaped software, live on four platforms
description: Built an app for a human-shaped problem in a cohort at humanshaped.org, and put it live on the web and on three more platforms, where other people can get it for themselves.

criteria.narrative: The holder took part in a cohort at humanshaped.org and built an app for a human-shaped problem, one that belongs to people rather than to computers. The evidence is the app’s repository, which holds the app and the record of how it was made, and an app live on the web at a real address is enough for the first level. Each further platform the app is published on, where other people can get it for themselves, adds a level. A teacher of the cohort opened the repository and every link before this credential was issued.
